content:
maria: Heads-up — scheduling a multi-region maintenance window Tue 2026-04-07 02:00–05:00 UTC. Plan: staged NIC micropatch + kernel micropatch in us-east1 GPU pools. We'll redirect hosted traffic and Dedicated backfill to eu-west1/apac-west1 while we reboot racked nodes. Need warm KV cache reseed and routing policy handshake.

tj: ETA on impact? percent capacity drop?

maria: Expect 20–30% GPU capacity reduction in us-east1 during the 2hr bulk window. We'll reserve burst capacity in eu-west1 to keep latency SLOs. Hosted API may shift some models to lighter/quantized variants briefly.

chris: Can we do a canary cohort first? Suggest 2 racks (~8 GPUs) between 02:00–02:20 to validate KV reseed, kernel boot and routing nudges.

maria: yes — canary -> cohort -> bulk. Ops will run KV prime before canary. Example command: `./ops kvseed --pool=gpu-useast1 --cohort=canary --mode=fast`

ben: cost heads-up — cross-region backfill + egress estimated ~$3.2k for the 3h window. If burst reserve runs longer could approach ~$5k.

kai: networking question — will this change BGP communities or do full ASN swaps? We should prefer route weight/LS-traffic steering to avoid long convergence.

maria: correct — plan is route weight nudges + traffic steering at the L7 layer. No ASN-level failover.

infra-bot: scheduled: maintenance_id=MRG-20260407-01 window=02:00-05:00 UTC impacted_pools=[gpu-useast1] runbook=<https://go/redwood/runbooks/multi-region-failover|runbook>

tj: runbook link looks good. who's oncall for rolling reboots and warmhandshake?

maria: oncall: chris (primary), ben (backup). infra lead: tj. Please be available 01:30–06:00 UTC.

chris: I'll own canary & KV seed. Will post a step-by-step checklist in this thread by 01:00 UTC. Need a small probe to measure warm cache hit-rate after reseed.

maria: probe idea: `curl -sS https://internal/kvprobe?pool=gpu-useast1 | jq .hit_rate` — target threshold >= 0.90 before continuing.

ben: recommend a cost kill-switch: if cross-region costs > $4k OR error-rate > 3% for 10m, pause backfill and hold. Need product signoff for automated gating.

kai: also need to message Dedicated customers with pinned zones ASAP. Draft comms: `@acct-team` please review — short notice, provide expected window and mitigation.

maria: drafted comms ready. Will send to sales/cs after a quick review here. Message will state: "Planned maintenance in us-east1, we will gracefully failover traffic to eu-west1/apac-west1. No user data loss expected. Expected performance may degrade for some customers for up to 2 hours."

deploy-bot: automation: none — this is a manual ops window.

tj: final ask — any eval/regression risk when shifting to lighter model variants during the window?

maria: low. We have fallback/rollback policies: if quality score drop >5% on the eval set we auto-revert traffic to previous variant and escalate.

chris: OK — sharing the canary checklist in 30m. Will include exact rack IDs, drain commands and verification probes. :thumbsup:
